menu: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished landscape 2D mobile game MAIN MENU concept screenshot for 桃园小英雄, aspect2:1, matching references exactly. Image1 current actual game UI is style/scene reference; image2 is approved five TEEN heroes identity reference; image3 LuBu andimage4 DongZhuo are boss identity style only, do not copy design-board panels/text. Retain sunlit open peach-orchard training-ground landscape, warm brown clean outlines, bright flat cel colors, grassy meadow. Minimal premium readable mobile UI; no '选择英雄' title, no stats, no paragraphs, no weapon selection, no level display, no test mode, no WeChat top-right capsule baked in. Small brush-calligraphy logo '桃园小英雄' top-left. Upper left/middle ~58% width showcases ONE large youthful chibi Liu Bei standing freely ON ground (no oval paper disc, no frame), expressive lively greeting with head tilted, clean-shaven tousled brown fringe topknot green ribbon, green/ivory robe red sash, each hand FIRMLY GRIPPING one golden straw sandal below eyes, tiny feet. Under him simple small jade nameplate '刘备'. On right ~32% width a beautifully rounded translucent dark-jade stage card, fine warm gold line, generous air: small top caption '刘备的征程 · 1/6'; wide miniature golden Hulao gate meadow scene thumbnail with tiny existing red-plume LuBu/round purple DongZhuo portraits, title '02 虎牢讨董', short subtitle '五波挑战', two little boss portrait chips '吕布' and '董卓'; bottom small elegant action '更换关卡 ›'. Clearly make stage selection part of menu without dominating hero. Bottom central row five compact square HEAD-ONLY hero avatar buttons in order Liu Bei / Guan Yu / Zhang Fei / Zhao Yun / Kongming, using image2 exact teenage designs; Liu selected golden edge, Guan warm peach face NOT red, nobody has a beard. One small circular skill-icon button immediately right of row, icon-only golden sweep, no labels. Under this row horizontally centered red-orange hand-painted CTA '开始挑战', generous safe-area margin. Small quiet jade buttons '图鉴' bottomleft and '演武场' bottomright. Screenshot should feel like a real shipped game: compact visual hierarchy, aligned baseline/padding, wide negative space, legible SHORT exact Chinese text only as specified, no annotations or design arrows. Do not redraw existing bosses into teenagers; boss portraits remain existing adult identities. This is an initial design mockup, not a screenshot of implemented code.
stagePicker: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished landscape game stage-selection MODAL concept screenshot for 桃园小英雄, aspect2:1. Reference1 is approved NEW MAIN MENU layout/style: keep jade/gold/cream/red typography and teenage Liu Bei, landscape; reference2 is current actual UI background/style; reference3 is five approved TEEN faces. Show the scene from reference1 dimmed behind a wide central SEMITRANSPARENT dark-jade popup with generous margins, minimal clean gold trim, can faintly see background andhero. Large popup heading exact '刘备的征程', a small Liu Bei teenage head next to it, tiny status '已通关 1/6', simple small close X top right. Six roomy landscape stage cards in a3columns×2rows grid, clean readable large short Chinese titles: '01 黄巾起义' (sunny green meadow/yellow headband flag; clear golden tick + small '已通关'), '02 虎牢讨董' (sunny ochre gate/fortress; selected golden border + small '可挑战'), '03 官渡争锋' (blue-green military camp; padlock), '04 赤壁鏖兵' (blue-teal moonlit riverbank/orange fire far away; padlock), '05 南中平蛮' (emerald jungle clearing; padlock), '06 五丈原决战' (purple dusk plain with faint stars; padlock). Each card is roughly160x90 proportion with illustration upper2/3andtitlelower, decorative backgrounds rather than big full hero cards. Stages3-6 clearly desaturated but recognizable, disabled/dark andpadlock; NO stars or fake completed progress; onlystage1clear,stage2available. Very bottom popup left quiet label '首通解锁' with THREE reward icon groups (halberd, broad guandao, peach? actually sword) andsmallcaption '武器 · 道具 · 技能'; bottomright compact red CTA '选择此关'. Footer line tiny '通关当前关卡后解锁下一关' readable. No extra texts/descriptions/busy statistics; no character stats, coins, purchasable locks, battle HUD, handdrawn arrows or WeChat top-right capsule. Existing main-menu selected hero remains softly visible at backgroundleft; all modalspace mobile-readable and aligned. Initial design concept, not implemented screenshot.
stagePickerRewardCorrection: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the small REWARD FOOTER ROW of this stage-selection popup concept. Keep entire canvas dimensions, scene, LiuBei identity, header, six stage cards, titles, statuses, selected goldborder, shadows and red '选择此关' button exactly as shown. The selected stage is02虎牢讨董. In the bottomleft row after '首通解锁', REPLACE the existing THREE SWORD ICON TILES and the generic '武器·道具·技能' text with THREE compact category reward chips: first shows a tiny gold/red halberd icon and EXACT short label '武器 +5'; second shows a little bright red chili pepper with green stalk and EXACT label '道具 +6'; third shows golden sweeping crescent slash icon and EXACT label '技能 +2'. These are counts, not three weapon rewards. All three chips fit comfortably left of the existing red confirm button on one aligned row, mobile readable, jade fills and thin gold border, ample padding. Maintain caption '首通解锁' and bottom instruction line. Do not change other labels or add new UI, no extra weapons or glow. This is a precise correction to a design mockup, not new gameplay art.
themes: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a coherent 3columns×2rows environmental art direction sheet for six BATTLE ARENAS of the humorous Chinese ThreeKingdoms2D mobile game 桃园小英雄. Landscape overall sheet, six equal landscape panels with narrow dark-jade gutters and tiny cream title labels in strips OUTSIDE the battlefield images. Reference1 actual game grass art defines stylization; reference2 stagepicker defines palette and six themes; ignore characters/UI in references. All six scenes must be actual wide OPEN PLAYABLE GROUND in the same slightlytopdown 2D cartoon camera, NOT cinematic horizon postcards, NOT sideview, NOT isometric rooms. At least75% of each panel is clean continuous flat ground with just sparse tiny grass tufts and small flowers/stones. Broad walkable area, no central architecture, no giant trees, no obstacles, no paths cutting into narrow corridors. Large decorative silhouettes restricted to remote TOP edge outside playable area; edges soft handpainted, warm brown contours where needed, saturated readable celshading matching small chibi heroes. No heroes, enemies, UI, dangerzones or actioneffects. SIX panels top row: 1 title '01 黄巾起义' fresh warm green meadow with sparse tiny pinkpetals and shortgrass, one SMALL yellow flag at farcorner; 2 title '02 虎牢讨董' dry strawgold meadow/ochre dirt, tiny grass, distant low Hulao gate only beyond topedge; 3 title '03 官渡争锋' cool bluegreen shortgrass and tanearth, tiny campflags and low tents on remote topedge only. Bottomrow:4 title '04 赤壁鏖兵' moonlit TEAL BLUE riverbank ground, bright enough to see characters, water only far beyond topedge with tiny orange burningcamp reflection, central arena completely flat andopen; 5 title '05 南中平蛮' emerald moss/grass forest CLEARING with broadleaves/ferns only in outercorners, central openfloor with sparse tiny ferns, no central ruinedtemples;6 title '06 五丈原决战' blue-lavender dusk shortgrass plain with sparse small graystonepavers and very subtle decorative faintstartraces in ground, NOT active danger markers or glowing runes, low distant hills attopedge. Avoid dark muddy colors, photorealism,3D, dense decoration, empty brown stadiums, mountains taking most panel, detailed dense grass texture. One unified professional initial concept board showing how actual battlefields stay readable.
